essence: The practitioner obtains victory in battle, gambling, and debate.
Gods, humans, and celestial musicians become submissive to the practitioner without doubt.
The eight siddhis, beginning with minuteness, are in the practitioner's control.
This knowledge must never be given or revealed to anyone at any time.
Violating secrecy results in the loss of siddhi.
